label: ManoMano
terms_note: ManoMano seller contract (FR / ES / IT / DE / GB storefronts); API key created by a Toolbox Admin (one key covers all the seller's contracts, shown once); 250 requests per hour per key; sandbox available only Mon 00:00–20:00 and Tue–Fri 07:00–20:00 CEST; legacy XML Orders API ended 2025-03-31.

discovery.auth: api_key (x-api-key generated by a Toolbox Admin under Settings › API keys; shown once)
sdks: Postman collection 'ManoMano Partners API' (community-published on postman.com)

auth: 1. Toolbox (seller back-office) › Settings › API keys › Generate API key (Admin role) — copy it once.
2. Send `x-api-key: <key>` on every request; one key serves all of the seller's country contracts.

endpoints.purpose: orders with filters; statuses PENDING / PREPARATION / SHIPPED / REFUNDED / REFUNDING

endpoints.notes: scope to confirm on the reference

reference.limits: 250 requests per hour per API key. - Seller contract per country; API key is the seller's own. - Sandbox has opening hours (CEST).
mcp_sdk: SDK: Postman collection 'ManoMano Partners API' (community-published on postman.com)

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: API key generated by a Toolbox Admin under Settings > API keys (shown once; one key serves all of the seller's contracts); sent as the x-api-key header.

config_fields.name: seller_contract_id
config_fields.help: Numeric seller contract id (one per ManoMano market and delivery type, shown in Toolbox); every call is scoped to it.

adapter.terms: ManoMano Partners API: about 200 requests per hour per IP on the Offers API (HTTP 429 beyond). The sandbox (partnersapi.sandbox.manomano.com) only operates Mon 00:00-20:00 and Tue-Fri 07:00-20:00 CEST.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe reads one online offer of the configured contract ({pagination, content[]}) to verify the key and contract id.

update_listing.note: update_offers PATCH /api/v2/offer-information/offers {content: [{seller_contract_id, items: [{sku, price: {price_vat_included}, stock: {quantity}}]}]} changes the LIVE price (VAT included, contract currency) and/or stock of one offer; `listing_id` is your SKU. By default ManoMano FREEZES the values sent so later feed imports do not overwrite them. Title/description come from the product feed and are not changed. A 207 answer lists per-SKU errors in raw.

set_inventory.note: update_offers with {sku, stock: {quantity}} sets the stock of one offer by SKU (`sku` required; the stock is frozen against feed imports by default).

list_orders.note: Orders API (REST) GET /orders/v1/orders?seller_contract_id&status(PENDING|WAITING_PAYMENT|REFUSED|PREPARATION|SHIPPED|REFUNDED|REFUNDING...)&created_at_start(ISO-8601 UTC)&limit&page. `id` is the order_reference (e.g. M2022080713464); total is total_price.amount VAT included; products, addresses and VAT data in raw. PENDING orders must be accepted (POST /orders/v1/accept-orders) before shipping; not done here.

mark_shipped.note: Create shippings POST /orders/v1/shippings [{order_reference, seller_contract_id, carrier, tracking_number}] moves the order to SHIPPED with one parcel covering the whole order (per-parcel products and tracking_url are not sent). Answers 204, or 207 with per-order errors in raw.content[].result.

not_offered.create_listing: Offers are created through the product catalogue feed (Taxonomy API lists the feed fields) or PUT /api/v1/offers with the full offer and product attributes; the vocabulary lacks the category, EAN, brand and shipping data these need.
not_offered.end_listing: No offer delete/deactivate call in the Partners API collection; an offer goes offline through the feed or by setting its stock to 0 (use set_inventory).

evidence: host partnersapi.manomano.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
